lines.trans: Well now, have all the journalists assembled already?
All the new stories are already in your email.
Yes, I saw them. This is a total nightmare!
Why a nightmare? We tried to do it well.
All of you need to work more and better.
You need to walk around town with a camera!
I am pulling your story about bitcoins from air.
But we already advertised it in advance!
This material is far too old and boring.
Is it really so difficult to find a good story?
Almost nothing happens in our small town.
Search for interesting news, I expect them in an hour!

снимать.gloss: to take off; to film; to rent

собраться.gloss: to get ready, plan to, gather

examples.text: Ты что, уходить от меня собрался?

стараться.gloss: to try, to make an effort

meanings.en: to try hard, to make an effort

examples.trans: He always tries to help his friends.

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

ходить.gloss: to walk, to go (on foot, regularly)
